verdict.rationale: Apify provides the building blocks for page monitoring: scheduled Actor and task runs (apify-docs-6), webhooks that fire actions such as HTTP requests to other services when runs finish (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29), and marketing that mentions tracking competitors (apify-docs-36). However, nothing in the evidence documents content-change detection or diffing for prices or listings, and the alerts in apify-docs-7 cover Actor performance and data quality, not changes to page content. So change monitoring has to be built by the user, and notification is poll-based on a schedule rather than 'as it happens'. Missing for 10: built-in page change detection/diffing, notifications triggered by content changes, real-time rather than scheduled monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
